item.title: Active - Azure Front Door - Connectivity issues in East US 2
item.description:
Impact Statement: Starting at 14:05 UTC on 22 Oct 2026, customers using Azure Front Door in East US 2 may experience connection failures & timeouts.

We will provide an update within 60 minutes.

item.title: Mitigated - Azure SQL Database - Degraded performance in multiple regions
item.description:
Impact Statement: Starting at 09:30 UTC on 22 Oct 2026, a subset of customers using Azure SQL Database in West Europe and North Europe saw slower queries.

This issue is now mitigated.
